findings.title: Every drive's members
findings.summary: 16 members across 13 drives; 4 are from outside the domain, listed first.
findings.note: A shared drive's members are users and groups only. Outside the domain means an address not in one of the domain's own domains or aliases. Files inside a drive can be shared further (with anyone with the link, say): this run reads each drive's members, not its files' sharing. It leaves out the 3 drives whose members weren't read, listed below.
